name: DIET 4360
title: Contemporary Nutrition Practice
description: Application of knowledge, skills, and competencies affecting contemporary nutrition practice in the clinical dietetics, food service management, and community nutrition settings.
requirement_description: A grade of C or better in DIET 3215, 3230, 3231W, 3235, 3250, 3255 and 3272; open only to Dietetics majors, others by consent of the Dietetics Program Director.
